scope: T05 anchor slots; planning only; no runtime effect

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: installed kiln, firing volume, fuel, maintenance
anchor_slots.review_note: The causal knowledge stack is sound, but broad craft and fuel effects currently operate without a maintained enclosed kiln or bounded firing service.

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: located waste ground, digging, separation, upkeep
anchor_slots.review_note: Siting knowledge currently grants settlement-wide sanitation without a paid, maintained waste facility separated from water and occupied ground.

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: existing well, built cover and apron, drainage, upkeep
anchor_slots.review_note: The discovery correctly protects rather than creates supply, but its safety effect currently precedes a physical wellhead project.

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: catchment, lining, finite storage, rainfall, cleaning
anchor_slots.review_note: The alternative lining routes are credible; operation still needs a paid cistern whose stored water rises with rain, is finite, and can become contaminated.

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: built basin, retained water, draw-off work, cleaning
anchor_slots.review_note: Settling has appropriately modest scope, but water-safety credit requires actual batch residence and basin maintenance.
The installed water-conveyance owner already requires surveyed grade, paid line materials, construction work, source flow, leakage, condition and repair.
Paid survey kits and site response records already modify selected building work through the existing construction and maintenance owner.

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: operating mortar batches and installed maintained masonry
anchor_slots.review_note: Real slaked lime, sand, water, mortar batches and masonry uses exist, but the discovery still grants broad passive effects before those stocks and structures operate.

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: paid surfaced route length, drainage, traffic, recurring repair
anchor_slots.review_note: Crowned and drained roads should change movement only where route segments are built and maintained; knowledge currently contributes global route and haul effects.

anchor_slots.stack_gaps: deliverable water, field allocation, turn compliance, loss and drainage records
anchor_slots.review_note: Calendars, drainage and tallies support scheduling, but yield and state effects currently do not depend on finite conveyed water or operating irrigated fields.
